scope: Local retained Habit activity and packaged read guidance; no live calls or deployment

checks.name: Release app and three Worker dry builds
Skill package, changed prose, strict future, repository consistency and whitespace

acceptance_evidence: Sixteen neutral expected pages agree across C#, shared TypeScript and synthetic Workspace/MCP reads with seven-digit UTC precision, explicit direction, normalized details and guarded paging.
Archived events/tasks and same-command batch events remain separate. Matching snapshots preserve old wording and null notes; missing snapshots explicitly use current details.
A forty-seven-event case proves no legacy recent-history limit. Invalid filters, wrong snapshots/operations/directions and mismatched stored command identity fail explicitly.
D1 reads use the current profile/connection/access-epoch guarded document/snapshot batch; stale pages, corrupted source and lost epochs never become empty history.
Public/private read grants and profile isolation remain enforced; warmed reads create zero preparations and upstream writes.
A synthetic canonical score command records three distinct events; repeat of the same command retains exactly three events and the original receipt.
Four packaged skills pass schema/tool routing; the new activity-review skill uses read-only canonical tools and separates accepted history from game confirmation.
limitations: Production mobile controls, streak semantics, real host/model activation and live qualification remain separate.
repairs: The initial neutral journal omitted hashes and matching accepted snapshot timestamps. The fixture now supplies independently computed v1 hashes and consistent timestamps and passes full journal validation.
